text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yesterday, some pickles arrived from my 
hometown. Whenever I eat them, I feel a 
strange surge of strength...
choice_data_list: It's because it's full of heart.

It's because you put your heart into it, 
isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
You're right... I have firmly received 
everyone's feelings.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I should be able to run a good race this 
time. ...Next time, I'll definitely win.

Seeing how thoroughly motivated Oguri Cap 
was, I felt certain we could expect great 
things from this race.
